before_times: A house, a townhouse or a condo? How many floors and outside doors?
Pets over 40 lb? (for pet-friendly motion sensors)
Any old alarm parts in the home?
after_time: Will an owner of the home be there for the survey?
Own or rent? A renter needs the owner's OK to drill and wire, by a link the renter forwards
secure_page_only: Photos of the outside walls, for cameras
intake_questions.never_asked: Alarm codes, verbal passcodes, the alarm call list, when the home will be empty, valuables inside (Rosie's rule)
intake_questions.who_may_book: An adult. An owner of the home is at the site survey and signs the contract; an adult is home for the whole install.

stop.words: a break-in happening now, someone who may be inside, an alarm going off now
stop.says: Get to a safe place and call 911. Rosie can't check, silence or send help for an alarm. Your monitoring center or 911 can.

stop.words: smoke, fire, a smoke alarm or carbon monoxide alarm going off
stop.says: Get everyone out now, then call 911.

go_on.words: a break-in that's over, with nobody inside now
go_on.says: If anyone may still be inside, leave and call 911. Don't touch the broken door or window until the police have seen it.

go_on.words: an alarm that won't stop, after the install
go_on.says: Enter your code on the keypad or in the app, and answer the monitoring center's call with your passcode. If someone may be inside, get out and call 911.
go_on.booking: the owner is told to call

go_on.words: a device battery that's swelling, hot or smoking
go_on.says: Unplug it, move it away from anything that burns, and don't charge it. Call 911 if there's fire.

safety_and_stop_words.business_line: Questions about silencing, resetting or reading an alarm go to the business's own line

prep: An adult home for the whole install (about 5 hours for a one-floor house)
A clear path to the old panel, the doors and the windows
The Wi-Fi name ready; Alex types the password into the app himself

staff.licenses_or_certificates: The company's alarm license. Each tech's registration and any background or fingerprint check, where the state's form requires them. Fire alarm work only by a tech with that license, where the form asks.
staff.who_oks: Sam OKs quotes over $500; Pat may OK them too, and Sam's answer wins
staff.stand_in: Another cleared tech with the skill may take a survey or an install; the customer says yes first
staff.roles: Jamal: surveys, installs, outdoor cameras and fire alarm work. Rafael: surveys, doorbells, checkups and service visits. Kayla: showroom consults, repair work and house calls. Devin: every showroom service but repair work.

children_and_age.who_may_book: An adult. An owner of the home is at the site survey and signs the contract; an adult is home for the whole install.
children_and_age.minors_texts: Never booked by a minor; a child at home never lets the tech in, and an adult stays home for the whole visit

visit.check_in: Site survey, install and service visits: the check-in code at the door. The tech also carries a photo ID card with the company's name and license number, where the state's rules require it; the reminder and the on-my-way text say so. Showroom: the code at the counter. A device left for repair: the code at drop-off and at pick-up.
visit.done: The test passed and the handover done, then DONE
visit.changes_at_visit: Extra devices at the install are priced and OK'd first. Work sold at the home gets the cancel notice where the rules give one.

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: if: an alarm or low-voltage license for the company, where the state's form requires one. Fire alarm work (smoke and heat detectors on an alarm) can need its own license or class.
license.who: The business, with a qualifying person where the state's form names one; each tech too, where the state registers them
ask: The company's alarm license number and its class
Each tech's registration or card number, where the state registers alarm techs
General liability insurance; workers' comp where the business has employees
A bond, where the state's form asks for one
license.background: Background or fingerprint checks for each tech where the state's form requires them. They show as the business states them.

never_in_a_text: Contract, permit and lease papers (secure page only, with a copy by email)
